item.title: Trump gathers Cabinet as he looks to seal deal to end war
item.description: President Trump will meet with his Cabinet on Wednesday at a precarious moment for talks aimed at ending the war with Iran. The emerging deal has already exposed the president to fierce criticism.

item.title: NASA lays out moon base plans with landers, buggies and drones at the top of the list
item.description: The space agency outlined the first phase of its moon base plans on Tuesday, awarding hundreds of millions of dollars in contracts to four U.S. companies.

item.title: Texas Republicans nominate Ken Paxton for Senate seat, ousting incumbent John Cornyn
item.description: Controversial Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton challenged Sen. John Cornyn's reelection and won President Trump's endorsement in the bitter primary fight that cost Republicans more than $100 million.

item.title: Trump-backed redistricting plan is rejected in the South Carolina Legislature
item.description: Republican state senators don't face election this year. Trump's urging for them to redistrict to help flip the House seat held by prominent Democrat Jim Clyburn was met with opposition.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Controversial Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton wins GOP nomination for U.S. Senate seat, South Carolina lawmakers reject Trump-backed redistricting plan, Trump's whiplash diplomacy on Iran continues.
